title: Predictive value of arthrosonographic parameters for hemarthrosis in patients with hemophilia (Follow-Up)
summary:
The aim of the study is to investigate whether there are differences in the knee, ankle, and elbow joints between healthy individuals and those with hemophilia. Particular attention will be paid to the synovial membrane.
The study will also examine whether these differences are related to the levels of certain cytokines in venous blood and whether there are differences between the two groups in this regard. This study builds upon the previously registered study DRKS00036781.

interventions.name: Sonographic parameters of the elbow, knee, and ankle joints of persons with haemophilia are assessed in multiple imaging planes. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients: Adult patients with hemophilia A or B
Control subjects: Adult male and healthy subjects who do not have any blood coagulation disorder
Exclusion criteria:
Patients: Acute injuries or joint hemorrhages, other coagulation disorders (e.g., von Willebrand syndrome), neurological disorders, diagnosed cognitive impairments
Control subjects: Blood clotting disorders, rheumatic diseases, acute injuries/previous surgeries/joint replacement of the elbow, knee, or ankle joints, diagnosed cognitive impairments
